forced_prepared_control.scope: Temporary test-only forcing on the standalone-shader candidate, not a production switch. Each run used 48 warm-up and 192 timed frames per local/remote capture.
forced_prepared_control.view_f8_msaa8: Forced selection also had no repeatable GPU-total gain; see all 6 f8 MSAA8 raw logs.
forced_prepared_control.off_mode: All 6 Off raw logs have exact identical color and depth signatures across auto/bypass/select.
forced_prepared_control.pixel_parity: Exact within each view and AA mode across all three forced paths.
forced_prepared_control.conclusion: The automatic path chooses bypass on B. Forced selection saves some triangles but adds draws and CPU submission cost without a repeatable total-GPU gain; retain the existing 16-probe heuristic.
